finalText:
**Build passes now.** Exit 0.

Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [src/core/options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | Read `options.retries`, bundler now sends `retryCount` | Accept both, type-check |
| [src/net/retryPolicy.js:7](src/net/retryPolicy.js:7) | Threw on `undefined` flag | Treat `undefined` as `false` |

The 8 remaining warnings are noise. They are `DEP*` deprecations plus `W1042`, `W2213`, `W3307`, hardcoded strings in [build.js:18](build.js:18). No code path produces them.

Next: `crypto.createCipher` and the `src/core/graph.js` circular import are worth real fixes later.
